questions.question: Two hollow conducting spheres of radii R1 and R2 (R1 >> R2) have equal charges. The potential would be:

options.C: Dependent on the material property of the sphere

questions.explanation: V = (1/4πε0)(Q/R). Since Q is same, V ∝ 1/R. Smaller radius → higher potential.

questions.question: The angular speed of a flywheel changes from 1200 rpm to 3120 rpm in 16 seconds. The angular acceleration in rad/s² is:
In circuits (a), (b) and (c) with two p-n junctions, the potential drop across the two junctions are equal in:
questions.explanation: In circuits (a) and (c), both junctions are in the same biasing conditions, so they offer equal resistance. Being in series, equal potential drops across each junction.

questions.question: Two objects of mass 10 kg and 20 kg are connected to ends of a rigid rod of length 10 m. Distance of centre of mass from 10 kg mass is:
A biconvex lens has radii of curvature 20 cm each. Refractive index of lens = 1.5. Power of lens is:
A spherical ball is dropped in a highly viscous liquid. The curve representing speed (v) as function of time (t) is:
questions.explanation: Ball starts from rest, speed increases with decreasing acceleration (due to increasing viscous force), then reaches terminal velocity (constant speed). This is curve B.

questions.question: Ratio of radius of gyration of a thin uniform disc about axis through centre (normal to plane) to radius of gyration about its diameter is:
A shell of mass m explodes into three fragments (ratio 2:2:1). Equal mass fragments fly perpendicular with speed v. Speed of lighter fragment is:
questions.explanation: By conservation of momentum: 0 = (2m/5)(-vî) + (2m/5)(-vĵ) + (m/5)v'. So v' = 2vî + 2vĵ. |v'| = √(4v² + 4v²) = 2√2 v.

questions.question: A long solenoid of radius 1 mm has 100 turns per mm. Current = 1A. Magnetic field at centre is:
T1 and T2 are energies in first and second excited states of hydrogen atom. Ratio T1 : T2 is:
questions.explanation: First excited state n=2: T1 = -13.6/4 eV. Second excited state n=3: T2 = -13.6/9 eV. T1:T2 = (1/4):(1/9) = 9:4.

questions.question: A light ray falls on glass (μ = √3) at angle 60°. Angle between refracted and reflected ray is:
questions.explanation: By Snell's law: 1×sin60° = √3×sinr → sinr = 1/2 → r = 30°. Reflected ray at 60° to normal, refracted at 30°. Angle between them = 90°. Also, 60° is Brewster's angle for μ=√3.

questions.question: If a soap bubble expands, the pressure inside the bubble:
questions.explanation: P = P0 + 4T/R. As bubble expands, R increases, so excess pressure 4T/R decreases. Hence total pressure decreases.

questions.question: Plane angle and solid angle have:
questions.explanation: Plane angle (radian) and solid angle (steradian) are dimensionless quantities but have units.

questions.question: When light propagates through a medium of relative permittivity εr and relative permeability μr, velocity v is:
questions.explanation: Refractive index n = √(εr μr). v = c/n = c/√(εr μr).

questions.question: 100 Ω and 200 Ω resistors in parallel. Ratio of thermal energy developed in 100 Ω to that in 200 Ω in given time is:
questions.explanation: In parallel, V is same. P = V²/R → P ∝ 1/R. P1/P2 = R2/R1 = 200/100 = 2:1.

questions.question: Graph showing variation of de Broglie wavelength (λ) with momentum (p) is:
questions.explanation: λ = h/p. Graph of λ vs p is a rectangular hyperbola (decreasing curve).

questions.question: A square loop of side 1 m, resistance 1 Ω is placed in magnetic field 0.5 T. Plane of loop is perpendicular to B. Magnetic flux through loop is:
questions.explanation: φ = BA cosθ. Plane ⊥ to B means B is parallel to area vector (θ=0°). φ = 0.5 × 1² × cos0° = 0.5 Wb.

questions.question: Dimensions [MLT⁻² A⁻²] belong to:
questions.explanation: [MLT⁻²A⁻²] are dimensions of magnetic permeability (μ0). F = μ0I1I2L/2πd → [μ0] = [MLT⁻²A⁻²].

questions.question: Two monochromatic lights of frequency υ and υ/2 are incident on photoelectric metal; stopping potentials become Vs/2 and Vs respectively. Threshold frequency is:
questions.explanation: Data in question is inconsistent. Declared Bonus by official answer key.

questions.question: In half wave rectification, if input frequency is 60 Hz, output frequency would be:
questions.explanation: In half wave rectification, fin = fout. So output frequency = 60 Hz.

questions.question: An ideal gas undergoes adiabatic, isothermal, isobaric and isochoric processes from same initial state (P-V graph). Which curve (1,2,3,4) represents adiabatic process?
questions.explanation: In P-V graph: steepest curve = adiabatic (slope = -γP/V), next = isothermal, then isobaric (horizontal), isochoric (vertical). Curve 2 is adiabatic (steeper than isothermal curve 3).

questions.question: Match EM waves with wavelengths: (a) AM radio waves, (b) Microwaves, (c) Infrared, (d) X-rays with (i) 10⁻¹⁰ m, (ii) 10² m, (iii) 10⁻² m, (iv) 10⁻⁴ m
questions.explanation: AM radio ~ 10² m. Microwave ~ 10⁻² m. Infrared ~ 10⁻⁴ m. X-rays ~ 10⁻¹⁰ m.

questions.question: Two particles make angles 30° and 45° with x-axis in displacement-time graph. Ratio of their velocities is:
questions.explanation: Velocity = slope = tan θ. V1/V2 = tan30°/tan45° = (1/√3)/1 = 1:√3.

questions.question: In Young's double slit, 8 fringes observed with 600 nm light. With 400 nm, number of fringes in same region is:
The peak voltage of an AC source is equal to:

options.A: The rms value of the ac source
options.B: √2 times the rms value of the ac source
options.C: 1/√2 times the rms value of the ac source
options.D: The value of voltage supplied to the circuit

questions.explanation: V0 = √2 × Vrms. Peak voltage is √2 times the rms value.

questions.question: Initial tension on stretched string is doubled. Ratio of initial to final speed of transverse wave is:

Statement I: Biot-Savart's law gives expression for magnetic field of infinitesimal current element Idl only. Statement II: Biot-Savart's law is analogous to Coulomb's law with former related to scalar source Idl, latter to vector source q.

options.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.B: Statement I is correct and Statement II is incorrect
options.C: Statement I is incorrect and Statement II is correct
options.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct

questions.explanation: Statement I is correct. Statement II is incorrect because Idl is a VECTOR source (not scalar), while q is a scalar source.

questions.question: As temperature increases, electrical resistance:

options.A: Decreases for both conductors and semiconductors
options.B: Increases for conductors but decreases for semiconductors
options.C: Decreases for conductors but increases for semiconductors
options.D: Increases for both conductors and semiconductors

questions.explanation: For conductors: α is positive → R increases. For semiconductors: α is negative → R decreases with temperature.

questions.question: Energy ideally radiated by a 100 kW transmitter in 1 hour is:
A body of mass 60 g experiences gravitational force 3.0 N at a point. Gravitational field intensity at that point is:
In nuclear reaction ²²₁₁Na → X + e⁺ + ν, element X is:
questions.explanation: This is β⁺ decay. Atomic number decreases by 1, mass number unchanged. ²²₁₁Na → ²²₁₀Ne + e⁺ + ν.

questions.question: Angle between electric lines of force and equipotential surface is:
questions.explanation: Electric field is always perpendicular to equipotential surfaces, so angle = 90°.

questions.question: A copper wire of length 10 m, radius (10⁻²/√π) m, resistance 10 Ω. Current density for electric field 10 V/m is:
Ratio of distances travelled by freely falling body in 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th second is:
Electric lift (max load 2000 kg) moves up at constant speed 1.5 m/s. Frictional force = 3000 N. Minimum power by motor is: (g = 10 m/s²)
Volume occupied by molecules in 4.5 kg water at STP if intermolecular forces vanish is:
Area of rectangular field of length 55.3 m and breadth 25 m after rounding for correct significant digits is:
questions.explanation: 55.3 × 25 = 1382.5. Limiting significant figures = 2 (from 25). Result = 14 × 10² m².

questions.question: Capacitor C = 900 pF charged to 100 V, then connected to another uncharged 900 pF capacitor. Electrostatic energy stored by system is:
Match: (a) Gravitational constant G, (b) Gravitational potential energy, (c) Gravitational potential, (d) Gravitational intensity with dimensions (i)[L²T⁻²], (ii)[M⁻¹L³T⁻²], (iii)[LT⁻²], (iv)[ML²T⁻²]
questions.explanation: G=[M⁻¹L³T⁻²], PE=[ML²T⁻²], Potential=[L²T⁻²], Intensity(field)=[LT⁻²].

questions.question: Two pendulums of length 121 cm and 100 cm start vibrating in phase. Minimum vibrations of shorter pendulum after which they are again in phase at mean position is:
questions.explanation: T ∝ √L. (n)×T121 = (n+1)×T100. n × 1.1 = n+1. 0.1n = 1. n = 10. Shorter pendulum oscillations = n+1 = 11.

questions.question: Assertion (A): Stretching of spring is determined by shear modulus. Reason (R): Copper coil spring has more tensile strength than steel spring of same dimensions.

options.A: Both A and R are true and R is not correct explanation of A
options.B: A is true but R is false
options.C: A is false but R is true
options.D: Both A and R are true and R is correct explanation of A

questions.explanation: A is correct (spring stretching involves shape change → shear modulus). R is false (Ysteel > Ycopper, so steel has more tensile strength).

questions.question: Ball projected at 10 m/s at 60° with vertical. Speed at highest point of trajectory is:
questions.explanation: Angle with horizontal = 90° - 60° = 30°. At highest point, only horizontal component remains: ux = 10 cos30° = 10 × (√3/2) = 5√3 m/s.

questions.question: Two media A and B: speed of light 1.5 × 10⁸ m/s and 2.0 × 10⁸ m/s. Critical angle for total internal reflection is:
Truth table for given logic circuit (NAND + AND combination) with inputs A, B and output C is:
questions.explanation: C = B̄ (output is complement of B). When B=0, C=1; when B=1, C=0, regardless of A.

questions.question: Series LCR: L=10H, C=10 μF, R=50Ω, V=200sin(100t) V. Resonant frequency v0 and source frequency v are:
In Wheatstone bridge for most precise measurement of unknown resistance X, resistances P and Q should:

options.A: Be approximately equal and are small

questions.explanation: P and Q approximately equal minimizes percentage error in measurement of X.

questions.question: From Ampere's law, variation of magnetic field inside and outside a long straight wire (circular cross-section, steady current) is:

options.A: Linearly increasing upto boundary then linearly decreasing outside
options.B: Linearly increasing upto boundary then decreasing as 1/r outside
options.C: Linearly decreasing upto boundary then linearly increasing outside
options.D: Uniform and constant for both regions

questions.explanation: Inside: B = μ0Ir/2πR² ∝ r (linear). Outside: B = μ0I/2πr ∝ 1/r.

questions.question: Circular coil: 1000 turns, radius 10 m, rotating at 2 rad/s. Vertical component of Earth's field = 2×10⁻⁵ T, resistance = 12.56 Ω. Maximum induced current is:
Two point charges -q and +q separated by distance L. Electric field at distance R (R >> L) varies as:
questions.explanation: This is an electric dipole. For a dipole at large distance, E = (KP/R³)√(1+3cos²θ) ∝ 1/R³.

questions.question: Nucleus of mass number 189 splits into nuclei of mass 125 and 64. Ratio of radius of daughter nuclei is:
